paragraphs: He is mentioned in Berakhot 63a, saying in the name of Rabbi Elazar HaKappar: “Whoever joins the name of Heaven to his suffering, his livelihood is doubled.”[^1]

notes.text: The whole Davidson Berakhot 63a paragraph fully names Rav Huna bar Berekhyah reporting Rabbi Elazar HaKappar’s dictum about joining the name of Heaven to suffering and doubled livelihood. The local full titles and reporting direction are supported; no additional biographical relationship is inferred.
